notes.title: UPDATE 10!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Reapers![/b]

We're back with another update!
As usual, we've been listening to all your suggestions and here is what we've done...

Version 29.0.16921.1405

[b]Seasonal Updates![/b]

With such a positive response about the characters, we've added a few special cases.
These special characters can only be unlocked by playing Finders Reapers at certain times during the year! 

Simply play during these periods and the character will automatically unlock:

[list]
[*] Dash, the crazy escaped patient - Play around Halloween (15 Oct - 31 Oct) to unlock her!
[*] Nick, Santa himself! - Play around Christmas (15 Dec - 31 Dec) to unlock him!
[*] Bunny, the happy gangster - Play around Easter (7 April - 30 April) to unlock him!
[*] Jeb, the straw chewin' Farmer - Play around Summer (15 June - 30 June) to unlock him!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/56bb7072ad7bae7b8497b536443dbecb323657e9.jpg[/img]

[b]Play Again![/b]

Didn't win that last mission?
No problem! 
Just hit the 'Play Again' button and bang it restarts the mission.
No more going through all those screens, phew!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/677609fe1953eafbfab23cf1af82c377e80bdafa.jpg[/img]

[b]Eliminator Exploits![/b]

Thanks to the community for pointing out the serious exploits that could be achieved in any Eliminator match. Safe to say they are all fixed up and no more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/10a9765b081387762c77b180bc3a71e5f962abde.jpg[/img]

[b]Now for something completely different... Combat League[/b]

While we're always working with the community on updates for Finders, we've started developing a new and unique game; Combat League.

Combat League is our spin on Rocket League, World of Tanks, Pro Skater and Speedball combined neatly into one arcade fun experience.
The team with the highest points at the end of the match wins.

How do you score points?
Scoring goals, making saves, eliminating opponents, assisting others and doing stunts (donuts, jumps, air time, slalom etc.)
Chain them all together for a killer combo score!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1397500/Combat_League/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/3ff49748874f7ac660204b3f7ed8e02a0d33c509.jpg[/img][/url]

Liking the sound of it?

Well, it's on Steam right now, ready for wishlisting!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1397500/Combat_League/]Click here for more info on Combat League.[/url]

Anyway, enough about that, Finders Reapers will be back soon with another new update (we have a few more goodies in the works!).
Until then, 

[b]Enjoy all![/b] ːsteamhappyː
(As always - any issues let us know!)

notes.title: UPDATE 9!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Reapers![/b]

It's the first post-release update, and we have some exciting things to show!
First up - thanks to everyone who has played so far - it's been amazing to see!
We've been listening to all your suggestions and here is what we've done...

Version 28.0.27521.1389

[b]DLC![/b]

Let's start with the DLC. 
We're so pleased to see so many players enjoying Finders Reapers that we've decided to create more characters. Mainly because people asked for them!!
So here it is - the first DLC - the Monsters & Icons pack!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/08b2a14c4a7a10cc129a267b59793a976fed7d94.jpg[/img]

[b]Character Select[/b]

One of the weaker menus has been the character select screen.
We've had a few complaints about it and you'll be glad to know it's been completely redone and is in full 3D!
You can now see your character collection with ease!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/4c7176bbee4041bad3df4f66eac627c1fae01f1c.jpg[/img]

[b]Dynamic World[/b]

The worlds are quite static - we hear you!
So we changed that - brace for dynamic vehicles - why not use them as cover!
We'll be adding even more dynamic elements soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/d80de4c353d03c917992371f8a3dc5b568d95e32.gif[/img]

[b]First Mission Walkthough[/b]

After watching many videos and streams it's become obvious that, well, it's not obvious how to play!
To help with this, we have added some tips and videos in the first mission to help point out what to do.
It's always the problem with a game that's a bit more unique for play - hopefully, this helps!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/af412376c5e1673dff3d6a5542e4d5f52d918547.jpg[/img]

[b]Improvements![/b]

Here are some of the smaller (but no less important improvements made from your feedback):
- Respawn time has been halved.
- The HUD bottom left has been freed up to allow for streamer video space.
- Cans in the tutorial now fade to stop multi shots.
- Tutorial on startup asks if you would like to play it rather than forcing it.
- Your team colour flashes at the start of a match to help know which team you're on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/ad7b919bbc7144eb1466480464274d4f2283f56c.jpg[/img]

[b]Fixes[/b]

Fixed - Players could go super high (like, really high) with new dynamic worlds.
Fixed - Rocket Launcher balanced for cost/damage.
Fixed - Nametags could rotate on all axes.

[b]Enjoy all![/b] ːsteamhappyː
(As always - any issues let us know!)

notes.title: LAUNCH UPDATE!
notes.content:
[b]Hello, Reapers![/b]

It's happened!

[b]FINDERS REAPERS HAS RELEASED![/b]

Version 27.0.14421.1190

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/d45c960646ee9f5961e2ed1d78fb40b3584ebd78.jpg[/img]

Thank you to everyone who helped shape and guide us through Early Access.

From providing great ideas to endless testing to bug finding to the online betas to...

It really has made Finders Reapers the game it is today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/7d4e7f7f2da0492f11d5fa28c60bbcee72e6d7b3.jpg[/img]

BUT WAIT! This isn't it!

Releasing is just the start of the next chapter.

We have updates planned to keep the fun rolling on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/20d8632fd8ab6b55dd041f443541f7fe10819416.jpg[/img]

[b]Until the next update - have fun![/b] ːsteamhappyː
(As always - any issues - let us know!)

notes.title: UPDATE 7!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Reapers![/b]

The final update for Early Access is here.
So what’s new in Update 7?
It's the big one, ONLINE has arrived!

Version 26.0.12321.949

[b]Online Mode[/b]

The most requested feature for Finders Reapers is finally here. 
After much beta testing and good fun, we're pleased to open up multiplayer to all.
It's 8v8, with bots being replaced by humans as they join.
Head on over to the lobby and find a game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/dd8712a5cc985cc4244e8649438b9556bbae324f.jpg[/img]

[b]Achievements[/b]

We all expect achievements in games now, and Finders Reapers is no different.
We've added eighteen to keep you busy!

[b]Player Tags[/b]

Quite a few people asked for this - player nametags appear above all players.
Above this, they show the team colours too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/1634e6fc4777c2581ec67f08d25e5f2ba3e9e061.jpg[/img]

[b]Progress goes 3D![/b]

Progression is a great feature and the old 2D based progression was, well, poor!
Don't fear though, we agreed and it's now all 3D and animated. Fancy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/8d7c9f7db9854c59fc61df3eae6bd8b4bb10c3bd.jpg[/img]

[b]Localisation[/b]

Another popular request! The game is now fully localised in 7 different languages.
English, Chinese (simplified), Russian, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese.
Just click the flag on the main menu and choose your language. Simple!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/1c72f516794240fc3efae4d7319948e0721925cf.jpg[/img]

[b]Feedback & Fixes[/b]

As always, we listen to the feedback and act on it!

Added - Suffering from a poor ping? Well, a poor ping warning will flash on the screen to inform you of a bad ping and possible bad laggy game.
Fixed - Rocket Launcher would sometimes not register the kill.
Fixed - Santa character (named Nick) couldn't be killed!! Incredible!

[b]Enjoy all![/b] ːsteamhappyː
(As always - any issues let us know!)

notes.title: UPDATE 6!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Reapers![/b]

Massive update 6 is here!
So what’s new?
Well, we’ve added a proper tutorial to help newcomers alongside 3 NEW MAPS!
Above that, there are now 40 missions to complete. Yikes.

Version 25.0.22121.437

[b]New Map - Farmlands[/b]

C'mon down to the Farmlands and enjoy some country chaos!
With Tractors, Combines and veg-a-plenty you'll be firing your way through the fields!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/c5eb9ef4106109e22fec5021d40da6f8a2a54429.jpg[/img]

[b]Tutorial Time![/b]

Finders Reapers now features a full and speedy tutorial to teach you the simple process of collect, sell, shoot.
You can try it at any time to refresh your memory or just get some practice in by shooting cans!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/2fd4791763f41b3290f8aa5bc43a2c78b2e2fca2.jpg[/img]

[b]New Map - The Docks[/b]

Welcome to The Docks - a military training ground to unleash your fury.
Navigate the crashed plane, empty buildings and duck through the assault course.
With lots of obstacles, you'll be embracing more short-range hits!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/a0121d89ed466863bf19f79d1123e1baf8246dc1.jpg[/img]

[b]New Shop![/b]

The old shop was poor - we get it! SO it's time to welcome the all-new shop!
See the characters in full 3D and even watch them perform your taunt before your purchase.
Remember, with well over 200 characters and 50 taunts, there's an option for everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/68f73488bc828e8f640475ef6a79858679dc7ec1.jpg[/img]

[b]New Map - Tranquil Bay[/b]

Arrrrr! Reapers beware, thar are Pirates ahead!
Run loose on Tranquil bay, a true treasure trove to play in.
Watch out for those skeletons!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/453ecad6575875e65dae92b3981c1cccd8430ba4.jpg[/img]

[b]Feedback & Fixes[/b]

As always, we listen to the feedback and act on it!

Added - 'Brightness setting' - You asked, we added! You can now set the brightness from the video options.
Fix - 'Missions are grouped by map, would be better to have them randomised' - Sorted, they are nicely random... all 40 of them!!
Added - 'Be good to have more maps' - We added three new maps! Enjoy!
Fixed - 'The shop isn't great' - We scrapped the previous shop and have a lovely new version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/b958382e2961b2e5466c8d9e8fb0a1a4ad45b7c8.jpg[/img]

[b]Enjoy all![/b] ːsteamhappyː
(As always - any issues let us know!)

notes.title: UPDATE 5!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Reapers![/b]

and hello Update 5!
With this update, we gain another weapon, the rather awesome custom mode and a fair few feedback changes!

Version 24.0.91120.295

[b]Custom Modes[/b]

At last, Finders Reapers now has custom modes - this means you can now make your own match and customise it your way.
Want a hardcore 20 minute Cash King? Perhaps an 18 player Last Man Standing or even a 1 minute Collect ‘Em Up with tough AI difficulty?
Then look no further than Custom Mode!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/c4c4da5046376acd25fa75b5441aae8ce98c0a34.jpg[/img]

[b]Shotgun[/b]

After the Assault Rifle and the Rocket Launcher we’re now joined by the Shotgun! 
You’ll find the Shotgun located within the maps - they’re scattered about but quite easy to find.
It’s perfect for a close up insta-kill but not really for the long range…
Oh, and it’s blue. A blue Shotgun? Only in Finders Reapers… maybe!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/8cc26efb6c2676e92ed61136d413ecb2308ed222.jpg[/img]

[b]Feedback & Fixes[/b]

We’ve had quite a few feedback requests and you’ll be glad to know we’ve made the changes!!

Fix - Options - the white text was too see-through - solid white now.
You said… “Missions are all locked at the start, would be better to have them available and can pick whatever mission to play.” - They are now all unlocked from the start!
Fix - Pause menu displayed controller prompts.
“The mission over end screen takes waaaay too long, I want to be able to skip” - Sorted, skip away in the mission over screens.
“Also, the xp/progress screen at the end needs a skip too…” - Agreed, and you can skip these too!
“Would be nice to see the next characters to unlock in the progression menu” - Good point. The progress screen (from the main menu) now shows the next few characters you’ll unlock - happy hunting!
Fix - Using keyboard/joypad to pause meant you couldn't unpause without a mouse.
“Would be nice to have a few characters unlocked at the start, rather than just one” - There are a few more characters available at the start, should help get a bit more variation.
“Eliminator rounds need to be reduced by players remaining - gets too long” - With each round the timer now drops by player count - far better!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/5e46927d0c02bd52a0ef04672d1555825b2fd7e5.jpg[/img]

[b]Enjoy all![/b] ːsteamhappyː
(As always - any issues let us know!)

notes.title: UPDATE 4!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Reapers![/b]

Time for another update and this time it's the biggest yet!
Hold your hats and prepare for some feature overload...

[b]Version 23.0[/b]

[b]Progression[/b]

Up until now, there hasn't been much to fight for, but that's changed!
Behold the progression system.
Every time you play a mission you will be rewarded with XP, the more XP, the more you unlock!
Cash collected, wins, kills and taunts all add to your XP.
Collect XP to get new and exciting characters and even cash.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/a53d50597e6a8668b6cd5cc49496bcb3ba22e26c.jpg[/img]

[b]Characters[/b]

Previously you could purchase up to 50 characters using in-game earned cash.
That was great, but it's nothing compared to what's on offer now...
Over 200 characters are now available. No, really!
Unlock them through play and purchase extras from the shop using your earned cash.
So. Much. Choice!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/601165055c3c0d98b63151c451b685d404bcd624.jpg[/img]

[b]Loading Screen[/b]

I know. I know. It was a black screen before. Well, prepare for some colour!
The new loading screen is much nicer and even shows tips about the game.

[b]Weapons[/b]

Weapons had to be purchased before the match and you were stuck with that weapon during the match - no longer!! 
It's a whole new system. All weapons can be picked up in the map you're playing and you can swap between them at any point in the game.
Time to start hunting for that rocket launcher!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/2adc0241d43a5dd6cd33338f1218c7bb1a2d148a.jpg[/img]

[b]Menu. Menu. Menu.[/b]

Possibly the weakest part of Finders Reapers was the menu system. It's been there since the start and functionality has outgrown it. 
A completely new system has been implemented and it's quick slick. 
Everything from play to shop to locker has been redone.
It even features the latest update info!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/34c17088b21dec5c3d8fb9102057d158c29131a5.jpg[/img]

[b]Options & Keybindings[/b]

It's been asked for by many and finally, a far superior options menu has been added.
You can change the game, control, audio and video options with ease.
Keybindings are there and ready for tweaking if that's your thing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/37f93945bf80355f82f77ff81975d418c5de3930.jpg[/img]

[b]Enjoy - It's out now! ːsteamhappyː[/b]

notes.title: UPDATE 3!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Reapers![/b]

It's here, the large update 3 has passed testing and has finally released.
This update is the largest so far, where to even begin...

[b]Version 22.0[/b]

[b]New Map - Outskirts[/b]

Finders Reapers launched with one map; Snack Central. However, it's now time to unleash the second - Outskirts!
Prepare to battle it out in a war torn, abandoned town.
The big feature for this one is the sole 24/7 convenience store located in the middle of the map to sell your items!
Carnage!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/d5f4c3800d2922236e3de52d6a13e7c9f7d509b7.png[/img]

[b]MODE x8[/b]

On top of a new map we now have EIGHT modes to play!
It started with 'Team Collect 'Em Up', the mode where you collected items, sold them and tried to earn the most cash as a team.
Let's have a look at the others:
Collect 'Em Up - It's a free for all, no more teams only in the collecting mode.
Cash King - Everyone must collect and sell to reach the target amount and win the match as the Cash King.
Team Cash King - It's no fun just having all vs all when you have the Team version of Cash King too!
Death Match - The classic most kills wins mode.
Last Man Standing - As it suggests, last player alive (regardless of cash) wins the game!
Team Death Match - Again, the classic but team based.
Eliminator - After every round the player with the least cash is eliminated leaving only one winner!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/4934ab36f470a63f09388290deeef2530837d78b.png[/img]

[b]Mission Success[/b]

Version 22 brings the missions menu and with two maps and lots of new game modes available - there are 16 missions to crack on with.
Not to mention the new screen and artwork for a smooth menu!
I've even added a tooltip bar to help explain what each mission mode requires.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/4dbea747aa84ce791084a60059d14bd5a743fc1a.png[/img]

[b]Kill Feed[/b]

At the top of the HUD in every match it now shows the kill feed.
You can keep a check on who eliminated who!
This was a requested feature, hopefully it hits the spot!

[b] Blue vs Red or Red vs Blue?[/b]

Remember always being the red team?
Well rest assured you are no longer stuck! The missions place you in either team now.
This was another requested feature, keep your requests coming!

[b]Fixes and Improvements[/b]

I'll finish up with the latest fixes.
FIX - Mission menu could flash before loading complete.
IMP - AI didn't shoot at certain times.
IMP - New audio during gameplay.
FIX - Unpausing would hide your items on HUD.
FIX - Character was controllable in certain ways during game over.
IMP - Quit at game over returns to mission not main menu now. 
FIX - Running sound effect would play during game over.
FIX - Top bar on HUD wouldn't update during respawn.
FIX - A draw would cause issues with stars being awarded.

[b]Enjoy - It's out now! ːsteamhappyː[/b]

notes.title: UPDATE 2!
notes.content:
[b]Hello, Reapers![/b]

The next update has arrived, so let’s take a look…

[b]Version 0.21.0[/b]

[b]New Weapon - Loot Launcher[/b]

A new weapon has arrived in the form of a Rocket Launcher; the Loot Launcher.
It’s time to blow your opponents away with some serious firepower… but beware, it comes at a greater cost to your cash!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/1a3199187ee94bacc8eb498bda1f48fad6ac65ea.jpg[/img]

[b]Locker Rework[/b]

With the introduction of new weapons, the Locker has seen some rather nice reworking.
You can select characters, taunts and of course new weapons all in this one handy place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/266fed25e62ffa397464014196623d30f41ed6a1.jpg[/img]

[b]BAM! ARGH! Hit Points![/b]

It was a bit annoying not being able to tell if you hit someone in the midst of a fast battle - well now you can! Watch as they exclaim great words of annoyance when hit!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/a3fe7e10eddd35db6e0463d0f2f4dbe1b193ec75.jpg[/img]

[b]Lamp Post Collision[/b]

How many times did you line up that great shot only to hit yet another lamppost?
No longer! Lamp posts have no collision with bullets now. Huzzah!

[b]Fixes & Balancing[/b]

Fixed - Falling through the world after death.
Fixed - Garbage collection could cause a crash at certain moments.
Fixed - Controller unplug warning would never go away...
Fixed - No weapon after spawning - You could sometimes respawn with no weapon.
Balancing - Costs of ammo in each weapon.
Balancing - Costs of taunts and characters.

Have fun!

notes.title: UPDATE 1!
notes.content:
[b]Hello, Reapers![/b]

Welcome to the first of many updates for Finders Reapers.
First, let me say thank you to everyone that's taken the leap of faith, jumped in and given it a bash!

It's great to hear the feedback from reviews, Discord, emails and DMs! 
This feedback has helped shape the first update - so let's take a look...

[b]Version 0.20.0[/b]

[b]Health Packs[/b]

There have been a few shouts for health packs and you'll be glad to know they are now implemented and in-game. It was very frustrating getting towards near-zero health and knowing you couldn't do anything but hope for the best! So fear not, these packs can be found in various locations in the level with a rather fetching pink outline for visibility.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/9894e5623fa80369468bc6e11b6dabfc7ec77d42.jpg[/img]

[b]Spawn Invincibility[/b]

Possibly the best part of this update is the change to the amount of time you were considered invincible after respawning. Previously it was set to 10 seconds. I know. Crazy. It's a much more sane 3 seconds and feels so much better for it.

[b]Intro Sequence[/b]

The match start intro sequence is now informative and explains the type of game mode, players and the actual mission objective. Obviously, there is only one game mode at the moment ('Collect 'em up') but more will be coming. Stay tuned for that!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987633/1889c6e7d9a6ddfd409859db0f6c0728515c5c41.jpg[/img]

[b]More 'First Time' Help[/b]

It's difficult trying to explain how to play and the last thing I want is to make you watch a video! Sammy the Seagull pops up and tries to explain that you need to collect items, sell them and that cash is your ammo but he was easily missed. Now, if you keep trying to fire, Sammy gives a much longer message to try and aid any confusion.

[b]Fixes![/b]

No update for any game would be complete without fixes.
The more interesting ones include plugging some collision gaps in Fast Food City, removing a black wall that blocked a pathway, campaign mode wouldn't select the next mission automatically. I won't bore you with others.


Have fun!
